waitlist.title: Step 8: Waitlist
waitlist.description: Allow players to join a waitlist if the event reaches max capacity.
waitlist.enableHelp: When the event is full, players can join a waitlist and be admitted if spots open up.
waitlist.modeDesc.first_registered: The team/player who joined the waitlist first gets the open slot.
waitlist.modeDesc.fcfs_room: All waitlist teams get the room ID + password; first to join the room claims the slot. You confirm who got in.
waitlist.modeDesc.manual_admin: You manually choose which waitlist team/player takes each open slot.
waitlist.capacityHelp: Maximum number of players allowed on the waitlist.
waitlist.discordRoleHelp: Discord role assigned to players on the waitlist.

paidTerms.title: Paid event terms
paidTerms.description: Before you collect entry fees, please review and accept how paid tournaments work on AFC. You only need to accept this once per organization.
paidTerms.escrowBody: Entry fees are held in escrow by the payment processor, not by you. AFC releases the payout to your organization only after the event runs.
paidTerms.feeBody: The first 10 paid tournaments per organization have a 0 percent AFC fee. After that, AFC takes 2 percent of entry fees collected.
paidTerms.refundsBody: If an event is cancelled, AFC can refund registrants their entry fees.
paidTerms.runBody: You are required to run the event you collected entry fees for. Failing to do so can lead to refunds and removal from the platform.
prizeSuggest.title: Suggest a prize split
prizeSuggest.description: Pick how many places get paid and the shape of the curve. Nothing changes until you apply it.
prizeSuggest.shapes.top_heavy.name: Concentrated at the top
prizeSuggest.shapes.top_heavy.hint: Each place gets half of the place above it. This is what AFC paid out at 3 and 6 places.
prizeSuggest.shapes.balanced.name: Balanced
prizeSuggest.shapes.balanced.hint: 2nd still gets half of 1st, then the curve tapers more gently so the lower places keep a real share. This is what AFC paid out at 12 places.
prizeSuggest.shapes.flat.name: Equal
prizeSuggest.shapes.flat.hint: Every place gets the same amount.
prizeSuggest.roundingNote: Amounts are rounded down to keep them tidy, and the {amount} {currency} left over goes to 1st place. The lines always add up to the full prize pool.
prizeSuggest.noPool: Enter the prize pool cash value first, then come back for a suggestion.
prizeSuggest.poolTooSmall: That prize pool is too small to split across {places} places.
prizeSuggest.replaceWarning: This event already has prize amounts entered. Applying this will overwrite every line.
